# MC Property Repairs Limited

> MC Property Repairs Limited is a building company run by its director, Mark Cartledge, based in Southampton, Hampshire, UK. Mark is the sole point of contact for every job, from first quote to final walkthrough — nothing is subcontracted out to strangers.

## Services

MC Property Repairs Limited covers:
- Bathroom fitting — full fit-outs and refurbishments, including tiling and plumbing coordination
- Kitchen fitting — strip-out to final finish, including units, worktops and carpentry
- Patio laying and outdoor paving, with proper prep and drainage falls
- Fencing — garden and boundary panels, posts and gates
- En suite fitting and installation
- Plastering — skimming and re-plastering
- Painting and decorating, interior and exterior
- Stud wall partitions

## Coverage area

Southampton, Hampshire, UK, and the surrounding area.

## Key facts

- Quotes are free and no-obligation.
- Mark Cartledge is fully insured.
- No job is considered too small.
- Quotes are typically confirmed within 48 hours.
- Available Monday to Saturday.
